subject: Sundial Biosystems — Provisioning playbook & MAP (CS kickoff prep)
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Soto <elena@sundialbio.com>, Sundial Onboarding <onboarding@sundialbio.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Sundial MAP + provisioning checklist — ready for CS handoff

Marissa / Monica —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning with Elena and the Sundial team. Per our agreement, attaching the draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that captures the milestones we discussed, key owners, and target dates. High level:

- Week 0 (7/19–7/23): procurement & security questionnaire clearance
- Week 1 (7/26–7/30): staging environment provisioning & SSO config
- Week 2 (8/2–8/6): pilot dataset load + smoke tests
- Week 4 (8/16): production cutover (target)

Please treat the attached XLSX as the working copy — I left empty columns for CS to fill in session leads, escalation contacts, and exact calendar dates. Sundial is keen to get a kickoff next Tuesday morning (US/PDT).

Key asks from Sales:
- Confirm go-live target window (Sundial prefers mid-August)
- Identify any outstanding procurement approvals that will block provisioning (they mentioned a 3rd-party firewall exception)

Attachments: Sundial_MAP_20260714.xlsx, Sundial_Procurement_Checklist.pdf

I’ll sync the HubSpot record (HS-78342) with any calendar invites. Marissa — can you lead the kickoff and propose a 60/90/180-day adoption measurement cadence? Monica — can you prepare the pre-provisioning inventory (service accounts, IP allowlist, cert requirements)?

Thanks,
Aditya
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Elena Soto <elena@sundialbio.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sundial Onboarding <onboarding@sundialbio.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sundial MAP + provisioning checklist — quick clarifications

Aditya / Marissa —

Thanks for sending over the MAP. A couple of items from our side before the kickoff: 

1) Procurement: we have an internal approval queue for firewall exceptions that usually takes 5–7 business days. The exception is to allow outbound connections to a managed inference endpoint. I attached our procurement checklist notes (Sundial_Procurement_Checklist.pdf) with the internal ticket ID: SB-4991. If Redwood can provide a short, one-paragraph technical justification stating only the minimum required IPs/ports, that will speed approvals.

2) SSO: Our identity team needs the redirect URI and entity ID for SAML. Can you confirm they can test in the staging environment before the pilot?

3) Go-live window: mid-August is preferred but we are constrained by a regulatory review scheduled 8/10–8/14. If we can cut over the week of 8/16 that still works.

We can do the Tuesday morning kickoff but would like an agenda that includes a 15-minute procurement/legal sync to review outstanding items.

Best,
Elena Soto
Director of IT & Security | Sundial Biosystems
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena@sundialbio.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sundial Onboarding <onboarding@sundialbio.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 09:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Sundial MAP + provisioning checklist — kickoff confirmation & owners

Elena / Team —

Appreciate the notes, Elena. Confirmed: Tuesday 21 Jul, 10:00–11:00 PDT for the kickoff (calendar invite to follow). Draft agenda below: 

1) Introductions & objectives (10m) — Marissa (CS)
2) Timeline walk-through (15m) — Aditya (Sales)
3) Procurement/legal blockers (15m) — Ben (Solutions) + Sundial legal
4) SSO & staging access plan (10m) — Monica (Ops)
5) Pilot success criteria & data handling (10m) — Marissa
6) Next steps & owner commitments (10m)

Owner assignments (initial):
- CS kickoff lead & success metrics: marissa_cole
- Staging provisioning & SSO: monica_patel
- Firewall/procurement liaison: ben_carter
- AE point of contact & timeline updates: aditya_rao

Action items before the kickoff:
- Ben: prepare a one-paragraph technical justification for the firewall exception for SB-4991 (Ben — can you draft and share by EOD Friday?)
- Monica: upload pre-provisioning inventory (service accounts, IP ranges, cert expectations) to the shared MAP (link below)
- Sundial: confirm who from legal/onboarding will join the 15-minute procurement sync

Links and attachments: Sundial_MAP_20260714.xlsx (working copy), preprovisioning-inventory.csv (to be uploaded)

See you Tuesday — I will propose the 60/90/180-day health-check cadence in the kickoff and capture signoffs in the MAP.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>

All —

I uploaded the initial pre-provisioning inventory to the MAP (file: preprovisioning-inventory.csv). Summary of key fields included: service_account_email, expected_eips, allowed_cidrs, cert_requirements, sso_entity_id_placeholder. A couple of notes:

- Service accounts: we will create two staging service accounts (staging-ingest@redwood-sundial and staging-infer@redwood-sundial).
- IPs: We propose using the managed endpoint range 34.210.XX.XX/28 (placeholder) — Ben, please finalize and Ben / Aditya please provide the one-paragraph justification for SB-4991 so Sundial can attach it to their ticket.
- SAML: Monica has added placeholder redirect URIs in the MAP; Elena, can your identity team confirm these before EOD Monday?

Attachments: preprovisioning-inventory.csv

Monica Patel
Implementation Operations | Redwood Inference
